title: Promotions Acceptance Terms: Coupons, Pals Rewards Certificates and Substitutions on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
These acceptance terms state, per fulfillment method of Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, how many promotional coupons an order may use, whether Pals Rewards certificates are accepted, how an order-level coupon and certificates are spread over the order's lines for refunds, and whether an out-of-stock item may be substituted.

| Fulfillment method | Promotional coupons usable on one order | Pals Rewards certificates accepted | Coupon spread over lines for refunds | Certificates spread over lines for refunds | Out-of-stock item may be substituted (customer allowed substitutions) | Price charged for a substitute |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Ship-to-Home | 1 | Yes | Pro rata by line subtotal | Pro rata by line subtotal | No | Lower of original and substitute |
| Expedited Ship-to-Home | 1 | Yes | Pro rata by line subtotal | Pro rata by line subtotal | No | Lower of original and substitute |
| Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 1 | Yes | Pro rata by line subtotal | Pro rata by line subtotal | Yes | Lower of original and substitute |
| Curbside Pickup | 1 | Yes | Pro rata by line subtotal | Pro rata by line subtotal | Yes | Lower of original and substitute |
| Same-Day Delivery | 1 | Yes | Pro rata by line subtotal | Pro rata by line subtotal | Yes | Lower of original and substitute |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 1 | No | Pro rata by line subtotal | Pro rata by line subtotal | No | Lower of original and substitute |

### Terms

- *Pro rata by line subtotal* - each line takes a share of the coupon or certificate in proportion to its line subtotal.
- *Lower of original and substitute* - a substitute item is charged at the lower of the original item's price and the substitute's price.
- A substitution is possible only where the method allows substitution and the customer allowed substitutions at checkout.

### Points of reading

- Every method allows one coupon per order.
- Large Item Freight Delivery is the only method that does not accept Pals Rewards certificates.
- Substitution is available on the store-fulfilled methods - Buy Online Pick Up In Store, Curbside Pickup and Same-Day Delivery.
